source_text: Adonisedec et reges quinque obsident Gabaon foedere iunctam. Clamant ad Iesum; ascendit nocte. Dominus consternat hostes; grandines de caelo. Figura: gentes adversus ecclesiam foedere Christi adunatam.
pass_a_gloss: Adoni-zedek and kings five besiege Gibeon by-covenant joined. They-cry unto Jesus; he-goes-up by-night. Lord confounds enemies; hailstones from heaven. Figure: nations against church by-covenant of-Christ united.
pass_b_english: [[Adoni-zedek and five kings besiege Gibeon, Israel’s ally >> Bible:Joshua 10:1-5]]. They cry to Jesus; he goes up by night. The Lord throws enemies into panic; [[hailstones from heaven >> Bible:Joshua 10:11]]. Figure: nations against the church joined by Christ’s covenant.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Joshua homilies; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105
